Volvo.hq_entity: Volvo Car AB (Volvo Cars; 78.7 % Geely Holding)
Volvo.note: Swedish brand under Chinese (Geely) ownership; XC90, XC60, V60 and EX60 come from Torslanda (SE), XC40 and EX30 from Ghent (BE), ES90 and part of XC60/EX30 from China, EX90 from Ridgeville (US).

Polestar.hq_entity: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC (operational HQ Torslanda; legal seat Bristol, UK)
Polestar.note: Swedish brand with no Swedish production: Polestar 2 (Luqiao), 4 (Hangzhou Bay/Ningbo) and 5 (Chongqing/Wuhan) are built in China, but the Polestar 3 has been built only in Ridgeville, South Carolina (US) since March 2026, and the 4 is also built in Busan (KR) – three of four models Chinese-built is not 'nearly all', so no second flag (CN would be the majority choice).

Lynk & Co.hq_entity: Lynk & Co Automotive Technology Co., Ltd (51 % Zeekr Group, 49 % Geely Auto)
Lynk & Co.note: Wikipedia's lead and infobox call it a Chinese brand headquartered in Hangzhou; the European business (Lynk & Co Europe/International) is based in Gothenburg and since March 2026 Volvo Cars is the exclusive European importer. Wikipedia lists only Chinese plants for the European models (01 and 08 Meishan/Ningbo, 02 Zhangjiakou); no Ghent production is mentioned.

Zeekr.hq_entity: Zeekr Intelligent Technology Holding Limited (Zeekr Group; 100 % Geely Auto)

Lotus.hq_entity: Lotus Group / Lotus Cars (Geely Holding; consolidated into Wuhan-based Lotus Technology Inc. in August 2026)
Lotus.note: British marque: Emira and Evija are built at Hethel, but the electric Eletre and Emeya are built by Lotus Technology in Wuhan (CN) – half the range, so no second flag. Wikipedia still gives Hethel as head office although Lotus Cars was folded into the Wuhan-based Lotus Technology in August 2026.

Farizon.hq_entity: Farizon Auto (commercial-vehicle brand of Zhejiang Geely Holding)

LEVC.hq: Ansty Park, near Coventry, England, United Kingdom

Geely Holding.hq_entity: Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co., Ltd.
